chapters.title: FLOW
chapters.about: Title card over the landing page: what FLOW is, and that everything outside FLOW is simulated.

chapters.title: Own books in six steps
chapters.about: Blank books: sign-in, the saved setup draft walked through its six steps, the first forecast, signing the limits; Home answers from the owner's own figures.

chapters.title: Am I safe?
chapters.about: Second take, on the golden demo books: Home says cash becomes unsafe in 12 days and recommends a ¥405,000 plan costing ¥3,113.93.

chapters.title: The buyer asks
chapters.about: Demo shell chat in the buyer's role: Foshan's message (EX01: 1.2% early settlement for 60-day terms and a 1% rebate); the buyer sees only FLOW's two counters.

chapters.title: FLOW decides
chapters.about: Deals: the request checked against the limits: ¥28,326.92 over 12 months against the ¥5,000 cap and a reserve breach; Options A and B side by side; Cash impact and Business consequences.

chapters.title: The counter is sent
chapters.about: Review and send Option A to the simulated buyer (Demo, open to a counter): agreed in round 1, the planned funding runs.

chapters.title: The deal, followed
chapters.about: The deal tracker (promised against actual) and Your agreements.

chapters.title: The bank, then time
chapters.about: Day 2: the synthetic bank event posts the agreed early payment (matched on Receivables); the clock moves to day 34.

chapters.title: A late payment
chapters.about: Day 34: Home's alarm and priced cure; Receivables: ¥160,000 two days late, Chase payment; Ask FLOW speaks first: the late payment, the breach and the cure, waiting for the owner's yes.

chapters.title: The owner decides
chapters.about: Cash & funding: Queue it for my approval; Approvals: ¥200,000 at 32.5% a year, above the 15% the owner signed; the owner authorizes.

chapters.title: The loop closes
chapters.about: Day 38: the advance has landed (Cash & funding); Activity › Reconciliation: the receipt matched, chain valid.

chapters.title: A contract becomes invoices
chapters.about: Third take, fresh golden books: Dongguan's supply agreement read clause by clause, confirmed, then “Set up in my books” with the forecast before and after and the owner's yes (Tier 2).

chapters.title: Ask FLOW
chapters.about: Ask FLOW: “Are we safe?” as an answer card whose link opens the cash forecast, then “我们安全吗？” answered in Chinese, then a personal guarantee refused (Tier 3).

chapters.title: The record
chapters.about: Security and evidence: Download JSONL, then scripts/verify_evidence.py on the downloaded file prints VALID.

chapters.title: Results
chapters.about: Closing card with the offline judge results (scripts/judge_eval.py: functional tasks and adversarial attacks).
